messages:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — launch post + webinar preflight. Need a short SEO checklist: canonical decisions between /guestlist and /register, redirect plan for promos, JSON-LD for event, and 3 meta variations for A/B. Who's in?

Kevin Patel: I got redirects. will draft campaign-safe rules (prefer 302 for short lived promos). also add rollback tags.

Samir Rao: Ill handle JSON-LD + OG/Twitter tags. planning Event and FAQ markup so we surface rich results.

Elaine Park: Ill pull target keywords from the benchmark narrative and write 3 meta descriptions tuned to intent buckets.

Gaurav Singh: For gating, we currently have /guestlist (light gate) and /register (full). Recommend keeping /register as canonical for main event info; /guestlist can self-canonicalize unless content fully duplicates.

Maria Chen: Agreed. Also we need internal linking updates: add persistent CTA in Docs hub and Product page pointing to /guestlist with UTM params, plus a 72-hour top banner on the site.

Kevin Patel: Draft redirect rules (first pass):
```
# Campaign redirect rules
/webinar/social -> /guestlist?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar 302
/guestlist/submit -> /register?utm_source=guestlist-form&utm_campaign=webinar 302
/webinar/archive-2026 -> /register?utm_source=archive&utm_campaign=webinar 301
```
Notes: 302 for campaign-level short links; 301 for permanent content moves. Rollback: remove campaign params and point back to landing page.

Samir Rao: JSON-LD snippet Ill include in PR (will add tests in staging):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Production Inference Best Practices",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T17:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-05-12T18:00:00Z",
  "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://www.redwood.com/register"},
  "offers": {"@type": "Offer", "url": "https://www.redwood.com/register", "price": "0", "priceCurrency": "USD"},
  "performer": [{"@type": "Person", "name": "Maria Chen"}]
}
```
Will also add FAQPage markup under the webinar page.

Elaine Park: Keywords from benchmark narrative: 
- production inference webinar (high intent)
- reduce inference latency (informational)
- inference cost optimization (commercial)
Ill craft 3 meta descriptions and taglines for A/B testing and drop them in the content doc.

Gaurav Singh: Tracking plan: use utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, plus utm_content for variant. Add GA4 event for "guestlist_submitted" and segment funnel guestlist->register. Also update internal analytics to mark redirects as campaign events.

Maria Chen: Action owners:
- Kevin: redirect PR + nginx-safe rules by Mon EOD (owner)
- Samir: JSON-LD + OG tags PR with tests (owner)
- Elaine: meta copy + KW sets in content repo (owner)
- Gaurav: banner + doc CTAs + tracking plan (owner)
Ill coordinate UTM matrix with demand gen.

Kevin Patel: @seo-bot schedule a staging crawl after PR merge so we catch broken links?

seo-bot: staging-crawl scheduled for 2026-04-02T03:00Z. Results will post to #marketing-crawl-results.

Samir Rao: Ill include a unit test that asserts presence of JSON-LD and event schema in HTML.

Elaine Park: once I drop meta variants, ping growth for quick vote on preferred copy.

Maria Chen: Great. Reconvene Tue 9am to verify PRs and crawl results. Ping here if blocked. :thumbsup:
